description: Golden set for the rule cleanup in hushpen-core. Each case runs `cleanup::clean` on `input` and must give `expected` exactly. `spokenPunctuation` defaults to true.

cases.name: filler um and uh
cases.input: um I think uh we should go

cases.name: filler er and you know between commas
filler with its comma at the start
filler in the middle with a trailing comma
cases.input: so uh, the meeting is at noon
cases.expected: So the meeting is at noon.

cases.name: filler between commas inside a sentence
cases.input: I went to the store, um, and bought milk
cases.expected: I went to the store and bought milk.

cases.name: you know as a question stays
as you know stays
cases.input: as you know, it is late
cases.expected: As you know, it is late.

cases.name: trailing you know
cases.input: I mean it works, you know.

cases.name: like at the start before a comma
chain of fillers around commas
cases.input: I think, um, uh, we should go

cases.name: several fillers in one sentence
cases.input: Um, so, like, I think we should, uh, go.
cases.expected: So I think we should go.

cases.name: filler between commas after a greeting
cases.input: Okay, so, um, here's the plan

cases.name: that that stays
cases.input: I think that that is fine
cases.expected: I think that that is fine.

cases.name: three I in a row
cases.input: I I I want to go

cases.name: repeated to
cases.input: we went to to the park

cases.name: a comma between two words keeps both
spoken punctuation off keeps the words
spoken punctuation off keeps new line
spoken punctuation next to the engine punctuation
two new lines
cases.input: one new line two new line three

cases.name: question then answer
cases.input: is it done question mark yes period

cases.name: new paragraph after a plain sentence
cases.input: buy milk new paragraph then eggs

cases.name: period before a new line
cases.input: hello period new line world period

cases.name: engine punctuation around a new line
spoken command at the very start stays a word
scratch that removes the previous sentence
cases.input: Send it today. Scratch that. Send it tomorrow.

cases.name: scratch that keeps earlier sentences
cases.input: Buy milk. Buy eggs. Scratch that. Buy bread.

cases.name: scratch that inside a sentence
cases.input: I like cats. Send it today scratch that. Send it tomorrow.
cases.expected: I like cats. Send it tomorrow.

cases.name: scratch that as a verb stays
cases.input: Hello there. I need to scratch that itch
cases.expected: Hello there. I need to scratch that itch.

cases.name: scratch that between commas
cases.input: Meet at noon, scratch that, meet at one

cases.name: scratch that with a comma after
scratch that twice at the start
scratch that spoken
cases.input: send it today period scratch that period send it tomorrow period

cases.name: scratch that before a word stays
cases.input: first new line second scratch that third

cases.name: could not wait is not a correction
cases.input: I could not wait for it
cases.expected: I could not wait for it.

cases.name: no wait time is not a correction
no wait fixes a word
cases.input: I like apples, no wait, oranges

cases.name: no wait with a unit
cases.input: meet at 3 pm, no wait, 4 pm

cases.name: no wait with a longer fix stays
cases.input: call John, no wait, Mary tomorrow
cases.expected: Call John, no wait, Mary tomorrow.

cases.name: no wait keeps the rest of the sentence
cases.input: Meet at three, no wait, four, then lunch

cases.name: no wait with nothing before it
no wait after a full stop
cases.input: I will do it. No wait, I won't.
cases.expected: I will do it. No wait, I won't.

cases.name: no wait spoken
cases.input: meet at three comma no wait comma four period

cases.name: lowercase I
cases.input: i think i'm right and i'll prove it
cases.expected: I think I'm right and I'll prove it.

cases.name: ellipsis does not start a sentence
abbreviation does not end a sentence
mixed sentence
cases.input: um so the the report is due on friday comma no wait comma monday period
cases.expected: So the report is due on monday.

cases.name: mixed with scratch and paragraph
cases.input: um so I I think we should meet at 3 comma no wait comma 4 period scratch that period new paragraph thanks period

cases.name: already clean text is unchanged
cases.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Numbers one two three four five.
cases.expected: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Numbers one two three four five.
